text:
maria: Quick heads-up — scheduling a quiet-window deploy tonight 23:00 UTC. Runtime, router config, and console migration involved. Staggered rollout to limit KV warmup spikes.

sam: which exact artifacts? any pinned variants for Dedicated pools? :eyes:

maria: runtime v2.8.2 (hotfix), router config v1.4.1, console schema v2026.04. Plan is staggered warmup: 5% -> 25% -> 100% over 30m.

jordan: note: hot shards may trigger router eviction. we should bump eviction threshold for first 10m to avoid noisy rollbacks.

linh: request: hold console deployment behind product manual gate so UI fields don't show partial metadata. can we soft-pin console routes to the old schema for 90m?

maria: propose console-route pin ttl=90m post-deploy. manual unpin only after product OK.

ben: rollback triggers? suggest: global 50x increase > 0.8% for 5m OR p95 token latency > 350ms for 3m OR router.evictions > 3 in 5m.

sam: add gpu_temp > 83C as a hardware safety stop. also, for runtime rollback, wait 4m after canary stop to let KV stabilize before undo to avoid cache thrashing.

ops-bot: deploy-bot planning: wave=staggered-warmup, start=2149999900, owners=[maria,sam], canary_steps=[5,25,100], health_checks=[api-5xx-rate,router-evictions,kernel-p95,kv-warm_ratio,gpu_temp]

deploy-bot: staging preflight OK. canary 5% started -> 5m green. logs: "kv.warm_ratio=0.12 -> 0.45"

jordan: reminder: router change is a hot reload. fallback path: router config rollback to v1.4.0 (no runtime rollback) to preserve request continuity.

linh: product-bot pinged product for manual gate at +8m. product asked for console screenshots after canary 25%.

maria: we will hold console until product confirms. console deploy will be manual step w/ 10m SLA from product team.

ben: documented rollback cmds here:
```
# router fallback
deploy-bot rollback --component=router --to-tag=v1.4.0
# runtime rollback (manual after cool-off)
kubectl rollout undo deployment/runtime --to-revision=stable-2026-02
```

sam: monitoring rules to add: alert if runtime.kv.warm_ratio < 0.2 after 15m OR router.evictions > 3 in 5m. ops-bot to notify #eng-oncall.

ops-bot: alert rule created: runtime.kv.warm_ratio < 0.2 after 15m -> notify #eng-oncall; router.evictions > 3 in 5m -> page oncall and mute autoscaler for 3m.

deploy-bot: canary moved to 25% at +12m. product requested console screenshot at +15m.

product-bot: product preview: console looks green on non-prod subset. screenshots uploaded. manual OK pending a short UX sanity check.

ben: saw a micro latency bump at +10m (~12% at p95) but below trigger. keeping watch.

jordan: still prefer router fallback-only autopilot. runtime rollback is manual per plan.

maria: roll-forward approved by product at +18m. will remove console soft-pin TTL after 90m if no regressions; otherwise we keep pinned and iterate. thanks team :party_parrot:
